Subject: BrightPlan pilot — budget & PO criteria (recap)

Hi Maria / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to align on scope. Quick recap and the asks we agreed so your procurement can map to internal gates: 

Pilot parameters (what we discussed)
- Duration: 60 days (proof-of-concept, production-like traffic)
- Expected monthly token volume range: 5M — 30M tokens (spikes expected during end-of-month batch jobs)
- Target unit economics: BrightPlan is aiming for ~$1,200 — $1,400 per 1M tokens for the pilot to fit your forecasted CAC model.

Procurement checklist items we need to confirm:
1) Purchase method: PO (preferred) vs. credit card for low-dollar buys
2) PO threshold: does finance require a minimum PO amount for vendor onboarding? (e.g., > $50k triggers additional approvals)
3) Lead time for a PO to be issued (billing/legal signoff)
4) Any vendor security/compliance forms that must be attached to the SOW

Next steps from our side:
- I attached a one-page SOW + pricing sheet (redwood-pricing-2026.xlsx) with two consumption bands and a recommended $/1M tier for the pilot.
- If procurement can share the PO threshold and expected lead time, we’ll draft the PO-ready SOW and a standard DocuSign envelope for signature.

Action: Maria — can you confirm the approximate monthly budget corridor and the procurement PO threshold by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW-BrightPlan-v1.pdf (SOW, 2 pages); redwood-pricing-2026.xlsx (pricing bands)
From: Maria Lopez <maria@brightplan.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BrightPlan pilot — budget & PO criteria (recap)

Thanks Aditya — helpful recap. A couple quick answers from procurement / finance side: 

- Monthly budget corridor: Finance is allocating $8k — $35k / month for the pilot (so the 5M—30M token range looks consistent with our internal forecasts).
- PO thresholds: Anything under $20k can be done on our corporate card. PO > $20k requires a standard PO and finance lead review; PO > $50k will require VP-level approval and may add 7—10 business days to lead time.
- Expected PO lead time: For straightforward SOWs with standard terms, plan 5 business days after contract/legal review. If the PO hits the >$50k band expect 8—12 business days.

We do require a vendor W9 and our standard procurement questionnaire — I can attach the intake form if that helps.

Maria
Procurement Manager, BrightPlan Inc.
procure@brightplan.com | +1 (212) 555-0147
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPlan pilot — budget & PO criteria (recap)

Internal note / recommended approach: 

Thanks Maria for the clarity. Based on BrightPlan's budget corridor ($8k—$35k / month) and the pilot token range, recommended proposal: 
- Offer two price bands for pilot:
  • Band A (0—10M tokens / month): $1,350 per 1M tokens
  • Band B (10—40M tokens / month): $1,150 per 1M tokens (volume discount kicks in)
- Minimum pilot commitment: $15k total (to cover baseline infra + priority support) — aligns with their lower-end monthly budget and keeps the contract meaningful.
- PO guidance we can provide to procurement:
  • If they pay via PO and the expected pilot total over 60 days is < $40k, finance review should be straightforward (PO <= $20k cc option / PO 20—40k standard review).
  • For PO > $50k, flag to AE for executive assist (we can field a credit mem or offer staged billing to keep them under the higher threshold).

Attachments we should send back: updated SOW with the two bands + a short procurement FAQ (I’ll draft). I propose we also include a staged billing option in the SOW: 30/40/30 split so the initial PO stays under $50k for most forecasted runs.

Action items:
- Monica: send revised SOW + procurement FAQ (today)
- Aditya: confirm with Maria that staged billing is acceptable; ask if they need the W9/vendor intake during PO creation
- Tessa: hold a slot Friday for a brief (15 min) pricing handoff with BrightPlan finance if they want a lift-off call.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0233

Attachment references: SOW-BrightPlan-v1.pdf (we will upload v1.1), redwood-pricing-2026.xlsx

Hi Maria — appreciate the quick turnaround and the thresholds. Quick confirmation from our side:

- We’ll send an updated SOW (v1.1) with the two price bands, the $15k pilot minimum, and the staged billing option (30/40/30) so the initial invoice can remain under the $50k signoff in most scenarios.
- We can include a W9 and completed procurement questionnaire with the SOW package.
- If you could confirm whether the initial PO will be routed at the $15k minimum or if you expect to issue at the top of the monthly corridor ($35k), that will help us decide whether to preemptively request exec approvals.

Next step: Monica will drop SOW v1.1 and a short procurement FAQ in a DocuSign-ready folder by EOD. If BrightPlan wants a brief call with finance to walk through the staged billing and billing cadence, Tessa is available Friday at 10:00am ET for a 15-minute sync.
